column1: # Pre-registered experiment manifest — Block A: /orchestrate coordination-loop

# 1500, roadmap spec, Laguna S. This manifest re-measures THAT EXACT
# configuration at n=30, varying only the seed. It is a measurement, not a
# comparison: spec, variant, think budget, worker count, and round cap are all

# (P17 used 1-3; overnight-chain 1-10; p13 1-6; P20's live run 42). Seed 42 is
